acquisition method: The Q Exactive was operated in a data dependent mode with a survey scan range of 300-1650 m/z
alkylation reagent: The B cells were lysed with 0.25% sodium deoxycholate, 1% octyl-β-D glucopyranoside (Sigma), 0.2 mM iodoacetamide, 1 mM EDTA, and Complete Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Roche) in PBS at 4°C for 1 h.
alkylation concentration: The B cells were lysed with 0.25% sodium deoxycholate, 1% octyl-β-D glucopyranoside (Sigma), 0.2 mM iodoacetamide, 1 mM EDTA, and Complete Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Roche) in PBS at 4°C for 1 h.
collision energy: subjected to higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 27.
enrichment method: immunoaffinity chromatography with the anti-HLA-DR/DP/DQ HB-145 monoclonal antibody

MHC-II complexes were purified by immunoaffinity chromatography with the anti-HLA-DR/DP/DQ HB-145 monoclonal antibody produced in house from hybridoma cell line IVA12 (ATCC, cat. no. HB-145) and covalently bound to Protein-A Sepharose beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
fragmentation method: subjected to higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 27.
instrument: MHC-II peptides were separated on an EASY-nLC 1200 HPLC system coupled online to a Q Exactive mass HF spectrometer via a nanoelectrospray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: MHC-II peptides were separated on an EASY-nLC 1200 HPLC system coupled online to a Q Exactive mass HF spectrometer via a nanoelectrospray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: MaxQuant software was used to analyze mass spectrometry raw files.
